description: This file contains shell script code used for bounds-checking and testing access to mmapped on-disk file formats, specifically related to git pack files and their index files. It includes setup routines for testing scenarios, functions for manipulating pack files and index tables, and a series of tests to verify robustness against corruptions and malformed data.

methods.name: clear_base
methods.description: Removes the current base directory and restores it from a backup, preparing the environment for tests.

methods.name: restore_base
methods.description: Restores the pack objects from a backup directory into the .git directory.

methods.name: do_pack
methods.description: Creates a pack file from given objects, then computes its hash and updates pack and index filenames accordingly.

methods.name: munge
methods.description: Performs a binary modification on files, used to corrupt or manipulate pack/index data for testing.

methods.name: ofs_table
methods.description: Calculates the offset in an index file to its initial offset table based on the number of objects.

methods.name: extended_table
methods.description: Calculates the extended offset table position in an index file.
